scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tanktelemetry/sdk && concurrently -n intake,dashboard -c white,gray "npm run dev -w @tanktelemetry/intake" "npm run dev -w @tanktelemetry/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tanktelemetry/sdk && npm run build -w @tanktelemetry/intake && npm run build -w @tanktelemetry/dashboard
scripts.start: concurrently -n intake,dashboard -c white,gray "npm run start -w @tanktelemetry/intake" "npm run start -w @tanktelemetry/dashboard"
